summary: {member} proposes giving council a vote on the annual list that the public works director currently sets.
realLife: A Dickson council member asked about changing the policy that assigned the annual paving list to the public works director.
gates: Existing authority to set a paving list and a proposal to transfer approval to council.
inGame: needs: existing authority to set a paving list and a proposal to transfer approval to council.

turns.what: Keep the existing approval process in effect.

turns.pulledBy: Council adopts a new approval rule.
turns.what: Route the next eligible list for the required vote.
turns.writesBack: Record the effective date and responsible body..
